sourceDate.text: 條侯亞夫自未侯為河內守時
條侯子為父買工官尚方甲楯
景帝乃更封絳侯勃他子堅

value.action: destroyed the Lu clan and enthroned Emperor Wen
held strict discipline at Xiliu; praised by Emperor Wen

value.manner: starvation after refusing food five days; vomited blood

value.action: guilty of substandard tribute gold; marquisate abolished

units.zh: 絳侯周勃者，沛人也。
units.en: The Marquis of Jiang, Zhou Bo, was a man of Pei.
units.literal: Marquis Jiang Zhou Bo was a native of Pei.

units.zh: 其先卷人，徙沛。
units.en: His forebears originally came from Juan before relocating to Pei.
units.literal: His ancestors were from Juan, migrated to Pei.

units.zh: 勃以織薄曲為生，常為人吹簫給喪事，材官引彊。
units.en: Bo earned his living weaving reed mats, often played the flute at funerals, and served as a crossbowman in the local militia.
units.literal: Bo made his living weaving reed mats, often played flute for people's funerals, served as a skilled crossbowman in the reserves.

units.zh: 高祖之為沛公初起，勃以中涓從攻胡陵，下方與。
units.en: When the future Emperor Gaozu first rose in revolt as the Duke of Pei, Bo joined him as an attendant and took part in the attack on Huling, capturing Fangyu.
units.literal: When Gaozu as Duke Pei first rose up, Bo as attendant followed in attacking Hu Ling, captured Fangyu.

units.zh: 方與反，與戰，卻適。
units.en: When Fangyu revolted, Bo fought the rebels and drove them back.
units.literal: Fangyu rebelled, fought with them, drove them back.

units.zh: 攻豐。
units.en: Bo attacked Feng.
units.literal: Attacked Feng.

units.zh: 擊秦軍碭東。
units.en: He struck the Qin army east of Dang.
units.literal: Struck Qin army east of Dang.

units.zh: 還軍留及蕭。
units.en: The army then withdrew to Liu and Xiao.
units.literal: Returned army to Liu and Xiao.

units.zh: 復攻碭，破之。
units.en: Bo attacked Dang again and took it.
units.literal: Again attacked Dang, broke it.

units.zh: 下下邑，先登。
units.en: At Xiayi, he captured the city and was the first to scale its walls.
units.literal: Captured Xiayi, first to ascend the walls.

units.zh: 賜爵五大夫。
units.en: For this he was granted the rank of Grandee of the Fifth Order.
units.literal: Granted rank of Grandee of the Fifth Degree.

units.zh: 攻蒙、虞，取之。
units.en: Bo attacked Meng and Yu and took both.
units.literal: Attacked Meng and Yu, took them.

units.zh: 擊章邯車騎，殿。
units.en: He engaged Zhang Han's chariots and cavalry, serving as the rearguard.
units.literal: Struck Zhang Han's chariots and cavalry, brought up the rear.

units.zh: 定魏地。
units.en: This campaign pacified the territory of Wei.
units.literal: Pacified Wei territory.

units.zh: 攻爰戚、東緡，以往至栗，取之。
units.en: From there he attacked Yuanqi and Dongmin, then advanced to Li and captured it.
units.literal: Attacked Yuanqi and Dongmin, proceeding to Li, took it.

units.zh: 攻齧桑，先登。
units.en: At Niesang, he attacked and was the first to scale the walls.
units.literal: Attacked Nie Sang, first to ascend.

units.zh: 擊秦軍阿下，破之。
units.en: Below E, he struck the Qin army and defeated it.
units.literal: Struck Qin army below E, broke it.

units.zh: 追至濮陽，下甄城。
units.en: Pursuing the enemy to Puyang, he captured the city of Zhen.
units.literal: Pursued to Puyang, captured Zhen city.

units.zh: 攻都關、定陶，襲取宛朐，得單父令。
units.en: Bo attacked Duguan and Dingtao, raided and seized Wanqu, and captured the magistrate of Shanfu.
units.literal: Attacked Duchuan and Dingtao, raided and took Wanju, captured Shanfu magistrate.

units.zh: 夜襲取臨濟，攻張，以前至卷，破之。
units.en: In a night raid he took Linji, attacked Zhang, then advanced to Juan and broke through its defenses.
units.literal: Night raided and took Linji, attacked Zhang, advancing first to Juan, broke it.

units.zh: 擊李由軍雍丘下。
units.en: Bo engaged the army of Li You beneath the walls of Yongqiu.
units.literal: Struck Li You's army below Yongqiu.

units.zh: 攻開封，先至城下為多。
units.en: At Kaifeng, he led the largest contingent to reach the city walls first.
units.literal: Attacked Kaifeng, first to reach the city walls with the most.

units.zh: 後章邯破殺項梁，沛公與項羽引兵東如碭。
units.en: Later, Zhang Han defeated and killed Xiang Liang, and the Duke of Pei and Xiang Yu led their troops east to Dang.
units.literal: Later Zhang Han defeated and killed Xiang Liang, Duke Pei and Xiang Yu led troops east to Dang.

units.zh: 自初起沛還至碭，一歲二月。
units.en: From the initial rising at Pei to the return to Dang, one year and two months had passed.
units.literal: From first rising in Pei returning to Dang, one year two months.

units.zh: 楚懷王封沛公號安武侯，為碭郡長。
units.en: King Huai of Chu bestowed upon the Duke of Pei the title of Marquis of Anwu and appointed him magistrate of Dang Commandery.
units.literal: King Huai of Chu enfeoffed Duke Pei with the title Peaceful Martial Marquis, made him magistrate of Dang commandery.

units.zh: 沛公拜勃為虎賁令，以令從沛公定魏地。
units.en: The Duke of Pei appointed Bo as Commander of the Tiger Guard, and in that capacity Bo followed the Duke to pacify the lands of Wei.
units.literal: Duke Pei appointed Bo as Commander of the Tiger Braves, as commander followed Duke Pei to pacify Wei territory.

units.zh: 攻東郡尉於城武，破之。
units.en: Bo attacked the Governor of the Eastern Commandery at Chengwu and defeated him.
units.literal: Attacked the East Commandery Governor at Chengwu, broke him.

units.zh: 擊王離軍，破之。
units.en: He struck Wang Li's army and routed it.
units.literal: Struck Wang Li's army, broke it.

units.zh: 攻長社，先登。
units.en: At Changshe, he attacked and was the first to scale the walls.
units.literal: Attacked Changshe, first to ascend.

units.zh: 攻潁陽、緱氏，絕河津。
units.en: He attacked Yingyang and Goushi, cutting off the river crossing.
units.literal: Attacked Yingyang and Goushi, cut off the river crossing.

units.zh: 擊趙賁軍尸北。
units.en: North of Shi, he struck Zhao Ben's army.
units.literal: Struck Zhao Ben's army north of Shi.

units.zh: 南攻南陽守齮，破武關、峣關。
units.en: Marching south, he attacked the Governor of Nanyang, Yi, and breached the passes of Wuguan and Yaoguan.
units.literal: South attacked Nanyang Governor Yi, broke Wuguan and Yaoguan.

units.zh: 破秦軍於藍田，至咸陽，滅秦。
units.en: At Lantian, he defeated the Qin army, reached Xianyang, and brought the Qin dynasty to its end.
units.literal: Broke Qin army at Lantian, reached Xianyang, extinguished Qin.

units.zh: 項羽至，以沛公為漢王。
units.en: When Xiang Yu arrived, he made the Duke of Pei the King of Han.
units.literal: Xiang Yu arrived, made Duke Pei King of Han.

units.zh: 漢王賜勃爵為威武侯。
units.en: The King of Han conferred upon Bo the rank of Marquis of Weiwu.
units.literal: The King of Han granted Bo rank as Martial Marquis.

units.zh: 從入漢中，拜為將軍。
units.en: Bo followed him into Hanzhong and was appointed general.
units.literal: Followed in entering Hanzhong, appointed as general.

units.zh: 還定三秦，至秦，賜食邑懷德。
units.en: Returning to pacify the Three Qins, he reached the Qin heartland and was granted the fief of Huaide.
units.literal: Returned to pacify the Three Qins, reached Qin, granted fief in Huaide.

units.zh: 攻槐裏、好畤，最。
units.en: He attacked Huaili and Haozhi and earned the highest distinction.
units.literal: Attacked Huaili and Haozhi, first in merit.

units.zh: 擊趙賁、內史保於咸陽，最。
units.en: At Xianyang, he struck Zhao Ben and the Chamberlain Bao, again earning the highest distinction.
units.literal: Struck Zhao Ben and Chamberlain Bao at Xianyang, first in merit.

units.zh: 北攻漆。
units.en: Marching north, he attacked Qi.
units.literal: North attacked Qi.

units.zh: 擊章平、姚卬軍。
units.en: There he struck the armies of Zhang Ping and Yao Ang.
units.literal: Struck Zhang Ping and Yao Ang's army.

units.zh: 西定汧。
units.en: To the west, he pacified Qian.
units.literal: West pacified Qian.

units.zh: 還下郿、頻陽。
units.en: Returning, he captured Mei and Pinyang.
units.literal: Returned and captured Mei and Fenyang.

units.zh: 圍章邯廢丘。
units.en: He laid siege to Zhang Han at Feiqiu.
units.literal: Besieged Zhang Han at Fei Qiu.

units.zh: 破西丞。
units.en: The Western Chamberlain was defeated.
units.literal: Broke the Western Chamberlain.

units.zh: 擊盜巴軍，破之。
units.en: He attacked Ba's bandit army and defeated it.
units.literal: Struck the bandit Ba army, broke it.

units.zh: 攻上邽。
units.en: From there he attacked Shanggui.
units.literal: Attacked Shangui.

units.zh: 東守峣關。
units.en: He guarded Yaoguan Pass to the east.
units.literal: East guarded Yaoguan.

units.zh: 轉擊項籍。
units.en: Then he turned to strike against Xiang Yu.
units.literal: Turned to strike Xiang Ji.

units.zh: 攻曲逆，最。
units.en: He attacked Quni and earned the highest distinction.
units.literal: Attacked Qu Ni, first in merit.

units.zh: 還守敖倉，追項籍。
units.en: He returned to guard the Ao Granary, then pursued Xiang Yu.
units.literal: Returned to guard Aocang, pursued Xiang Ji.

units.zh: 籍已死，因東定楚地泗（川）［水］、東海郡，凡得二十二縣。
units.en: After Xiang Yu was already dead, Bo went east to pacify the former Chu territories of Sishui and Donghai Commandery, securing twenty-two counties in all.
units.literal: Ji was already dead; thus he went east to pacify Chu territory Sishui and Donghai commandery, securing twenty-two counties in all.

units.zh: 還守雒陽、櫟陽，賜與潁（陽）［陰］侯共食鐘離。
units.en: He returned to garrison Luoyang and Yueyang, and was granted a share of Zhongli's revenues together with the Marquis of Yingyin.
units.literal: Returned to guard Luoyang and Yueyang, granted to share eating Zhongli with Marquis Yingyin.

units.zh: 以將軍從高帝反者燕王臧荼，破之易下。
units.en: As a general, he followed Emperor Gaozu against the rebel King of Yan, Zang Tu, and defeated him at Yi.
units.literal: As general followed Gaozu against the rebel King Yan Zang Tu, broke him at Yi Xia.

units.zh: 所將卒當馳道為多。
units.en: Among the contingents assigned to the imperial road, the troops under his command were the most numerous.
units.literal: The troops he led facing the imperial roadway were the most numerous.

units.zh: 賜爵列侯，剖符世世勿絕。
units.en: He was granted the rank of full marquis, with the tally split as a pledge that his line would never be extinguished.
units.literal: Granted rank of noble, shared the tally never to be extinguished generation after generation.

units.zh: 食絳八千一百八十戶，號絳侯。
units.en: He received a fief of eight thousand one hundred and eighty households at Jiang and was titled the Marquis of Jiang.
units.literal: Ate Jiang with eight thousand one hundred eighty households, titled Marquis of Jiang.

units.zh: 以將軍從高帝擊反韓王信於代，降下霍人。
units.en: As a general, he followed Emperor Gaozu to strike the rebel King of Han, Xin, in Dai, and accepted the surrender of the people of Huo.
units.literal: As general followed Gaozu to strike the rebel King Han Xin in Dai, surrendered and captured Huo people.

units.zh: 以前至武泉，擊胡騎，破之武泉北。
units.en: Advancing ahead to Wuquan, he engaged the Xiongnu cavalry and defeated them north of the city.
units.literal: Advancing first to Wuquan, struck Xiongnu cavalry, broke them north of Wuquan.

units.zh: 轉攻韓信軍銅鞮，破之。
units.en: Then he turned to attack Han Xin's army at Tongdi and defeated it.
units.literal: Turned to attack Han Xin's army at Tongdi, broke it.

units.zh: 還，降太原六城。
units.en: On his return, he accepted the surrender of six cities in Taiyuan.
units.literal: Returned, surrendered six cities in Taiyuan.

units.zh: 擊韓信胡騎晉陽下，破之，下晉陽。
units.en: Below Jinyang, he struck Han Xin's Xiongnu cavalry and defeated them, then captured the city.
units.literal: Struck Han Xin's Xiongnu cavalry below Jinyang, broke it, captured Jinyang.

units.zh: 後擊韓信軍於硰石，破之，追北八十里。
units.en: Later he struck Han Xin's army at Langshi, defeated it, and pursued the fleeing enemy for eighty li.
units.literal: Later struck Han Xin's army at Langshi, broke it, pursued the defeated for eighty li.

units.zh: 還攻樓煩三城，因擊胡騎平城下，所將卒當馳道為多。
units.en: Returning to Loufan, he attacked three cities, then engaged the Xiongnu cavalry below Pingcheng, commanding the largest contingent assigned to the imperial road.
units.literal: Returned to attack three cities in Loufan, thus struck Xiongnu cavalry below Pingcheng, the troops he led facing the imperial roadway were the most numerous.

units.zh: 勃遷為太尉。
units.en: Bo was promoted to the office of Grand Commandant.
units.literal: Bo was promoted to Grand Commandant.

units.zh: 擊陳豨，屠馬邑。
units.en: He attacked the rebel Chen Xi and sacked Mayi.
units.literal: Struck Chen Xi, slaughtered Maiyi.

units.zh: 所將卒斬豨將軍乘馬絺。
units.en: The troops under his command beheaded Chen Xi's general Chengma Chi.
units.literal: The troops he led beheaded Xi's general Riding Horse Chi.

units.zh: 擊韓信、陳豨、趙利軍於樓煩，破之。
units.en: At Loufan, he engaged the combined forces of Han Xin, Chen Xi, and Zhao Li and defeated them.
units.literal: Struck Han Xin, Chen Xi, Zhao Li's army at Loufan, broke it.

units.zh: 得豨將宋最、鴈門守圂。
units.en: He captured Chen Xi's general Song Zui and the Governor of Yanmen, Chou.
units.literal: Captured Xi's generals Song Zui, Yanmen governor Chou.

units.zh: 因轉攻得雲中守遬、丞相箕肆、將勳。
units.en: He then turned his forces elsewhere and captured the Governor of Yunzhong, Su, along with the chancellor Ji Si and the general Xun.
units.literal: Thus, turned to attack and captured Yunzhong governor Su, chancellor jisi, general Xun.

units.zh: 定鴈門郡十七縣，雲中郡十二縣。
units.en: He pacified seventeen counties of Yanmen Commandery and twelve counties of Yunzhong Commandery.
units.literal: Pacified Yanmen commandery seventeen counties, Yunzhong commandery twelve counties.

units.zh: 因復擊豨靈丘，破之，斬豨，得豨丞相程縱、將軍陳武、都尉高肆。
units.en: At Lingqiu, he struck Chen Xi again, defeated him, and beheaded him, capturing his chancellor Cheng Zong, general Chen Wu, and commandant Gao Si.
units.literal: Thus, again struck Xi at Lingqiu, broke it, beheaded Xi, captured Xi's chancellor Cheng Zong, general Chen Wu, and commandant Gao Si.

units.zh: 定代郡九縣。
units.en: He pacified nine counties of Dai Commandery.
units.literal: Pacified Dai commandery nine counties.

units.zh: 燕王盧綰反，勃以相國代樊噲將，擊下薊，得綰大將抵、丞相偃、守陘、太尉弱、御史大夫施，屠渾都。
units.en: When the King of Yan, Lu Wan, rebelled, Bo, as Chancellor of State, replaced Fan Kuai in command. He attacked and captured Ji, seizing Lu Wan's Grand General Di, Chancellor Yan, Commander Xing, Grand Commandant Ruo, and Censor-in-Chief Shi, and slaughtered Hundu.
units.literal: King Yan Lu Wan rebelled, Bo as prime minister replaced Fan Kuai as general, struck and captured Ji, obtained Wan's great general Di, chancellor Yan, guard Xing, grand commandant Ruo, censor-in-chief Shi, slaughtered Hundu.

units.zh: 破綰軍上蘭，復擊破綰軍沮陽。
units.en: At Shanglan, he defeated Lu Wan's army, then struck and defeated it again at Juyang.
units.literal: Broke Wan's army at Shanglan, again struck and broke Wan's army at Juyang.

units.zh: 追至長城，定上谷十二縣，右北平十六縣，遼西、遼東二十九縣，漁陽二十二縣。
units.en: He pursued the enemy as far as the Great Wall, pacifying twelve counties of Shanggu, sixteen of Youbeiping, twenty-nine of Liaoxi and Liaodong, and twenty-two of Yuyang.
units.literal: Pursued to the Great Wall, pacified Shanggu twelve counties, Youbeiping sixteen counties, Liaoxi and Liaodong twenty-nine counties, Yuyang twenty-two counties.

units.zh: 最從高帝得相國一人，丞相二人，將軍、二千石各三人；
units.en: In all, while following Emperor Gaozu, he captured one chancellor of state, two chancellors, and three each of generals and officials ranked at two thousand shi.
units.literal: In all, following Gaozu, he captured one chancellor of state, two chancellors, and three each of generals and officials of two thousand shi;

units.zh: 別破軍二，下城三，定郡五，縣七十九，得丞相、大將各一人。
units.en: On independent campaigns, he defeated two armies, captured three cities, pacified five commanderies and seventy-nine counties, and seized one chancellor and one grand general.
units.literal: Separately broke armies two, captured cities three, pacified commanderies five, counties seventy-nine, captured chancellor and great general each one.

units.zh: 勃為人木彊敦厚，高帝以為可屬大事。
units.en: Bo was by nature plain-spoken, steadfast, and honest, and Emperor Gaozu believed he could be entrusted with great affairs.
units.literal: Bo as a person was stolid, strong, and honest, Gaozu considered him reliable for important matters.

units.zh: 勃不好文學，每召諸生說士，東鄉坐而責之：「趣為我語。」
units.en: Bo had no taste for letters. Whenever he summoned scholars and rhetoricians, he would sit facing east and press them: "Just speak up—tell me plainly."
units.literal: Bo did not care for letters. Whenever he summoned scholars and persuaders, he would sit facing east and press them: "Speak to me at once."

units.zh: 其椎少文如此。
units.en: Such was his blunt and unrefined nature.
units.literal: His simple lack of polish was like this.

units.zh: 勃既定燕而歸，高祖已崩矣，以列侯事孝惠帝。
units.en: By the time Bo pacified Yan and returned, Emperor Gaozu had already passed away. He served Emperor Hui as a marquis.
units.literal: Bo having pacified Yan and returned, Gaozu had already passed away, served Emperor Xiaohui as a noble.

units.zh: 孝惠帝六年，置太尉官，以勃為太尉。
units.en: In the sixth year of Emperor Hui's reign, the office of Grand Commandant was established, and Bo was appointed to it.
units.literal: Emperor Xiaohui year 6, established the office of Grand Commandant, appointed Bo as Grand Commandant.

units.zh: 十歲，高后崩。
units.en: Ten years later, Empress Dowager Gao passed away.
units.literal: Ten years, Empress Gao passed away.

units.zh: 呂祿以趙王為漢上將軍，呂產以呂王為漢相國，秉漢權，欲危劉氏。
units.en: Lu Lu, as King of Zhao, became Supreme General of Han, and Lu Chan, as King of Lu, became Chancellor of State, seizing the reins of Han power and plotting to overthrow the house of Liu.
units.literal: Lu Lu as King of Zhao became Han Supreme General, Lu Chan as King Lu became Han Chancellor, wielded Han power, wished to endanger the Liu clan.

units.zh: 勃為太尉，不得入軍門。
units.en: Bo, though Grand Commandant, was barred from entering the army gates.
units.literal: Bo as Grand Commandant, could not enter the army gates.

units.zh: 陳平為丞相，不得任事。
units.en: Chen Ping, though Chancellor, was shut out from the conduct of affairs.
units.literal: Chen Ping as Chancellor, could not manage affairs.

units.zh: 於是勃與平謀，卒誅諸呂而立孝文皇帝。
units.en: Thereupon Bo and Chen Ping conspired together and at last destroyed the entire Lu clan, establishing Emperor Wen on the throne.
units.literal: Thus, Bo and Ping plotted, ultimately executed the various Lu and established Emperor Xiaowen.

units.zh: 其語在呂后、孝文事中。
units.en: The full account appears in the records of Empress Lu and Emperor Wen.
units.literal: The conversation is in the Empress Lu and Xiaowen affairs.

units.zh: 文帝既立，以勃為右丞相，賜金五千斤，食邑萬戶。
units.en: After Emperor Wen was enthroned, he appointed Bo as Right Chancellor, rewarded him with five thousand jin of gold, and granted him a fief of ten thousand households.
units.literal: Emperor Wen having been established, appointed Bo as right chancellor, granted five thousand jin of gold, fief of ten thousand households.

units.zh: 居月餘，人或說勃曰：「君既誅諸呂，立代王，威震天下，而君受厚賞，處尊位，以寵，久之即禍及身矣。」
units.en: After little more than a month, someone cautioned Bo: "Having destroyed the Lu clan and installed the King of Dai on the throne, your prestige now overawes the realm. Yet you continue to accept lavish rewards and hold a position of supreme honor in the emperor's favor. If this goes on too long, disaster will surely overtake you."
units.literal: After more than a month, someone advised Bo: 'Sir having executed the various Lu and established the King of Dai, your prestige shakes the realm, yet sir receives rich rewards, holds honored position in favor—after a long time calamity will reach your person.'

units.zh: 勃懼，亦自危，乃謝請歸相印。
units.en: Bo grew fearful and sensed his own peril. He tendered his apologies and asked to return the chancellor's seal.
units.literal: Bo feared, also felt endangered, so apologized and requested to return the chancellor seal.

units.zh: 上許之。
units.en: The emperor granted his request.
units.literal: The emperor permitted it.

units.zh: 歲餘，丞相平卒，上復以勃為丞相。
units.en: Over a year later, Chancellor Chen Ping died, and the emperor once again appointed Bo as chancellor.
units.literal: More than a year, Chancellor Ping died, the emperor again appointed Bo as chancellor.

units.zh: 十餘月，上曰：「前日吾詔列侯就國，或未能行，丞相吾所重，其率先之。」
units.en: After more than ten months, the emperor said: "Some time ago I ordered the marquises to proceed to their fiefs, yet some have not complied. The chancellor is the man I esteem most; let him set the example and go first."
units.literal: More than ten months, the emperor said: 'Previously I commanded the nobles to go to their fiefs, some perhaps could not go, the chancellor I value greatly, let him lead them.'

units.zh: 乃免相就國。
units.en: Thus, Bo was dismissed from the chancellorship and sent to his fief.
units.literal: Thus, dismissed from chancellor and went to his fief.

units.zh: 歲餘，每河東守尉行縣至絳，絳侯勃自畏恐誅，常被甲，令家人持兵以見之。
units.en: Over a year later, whenever the Governor of Hedong made his circuit inspection and arrived at Jiang, the Marquis of Jiang, fearing that he might be put to death, would don his armor and order his household to bear arms before receiving the official.
units.literal: More than a year, whenever the Hedong governor on circuit inspection reached Jiang, Marquis Jiang Bo fearing execution, always wore armor, ordered his family to hold weapons to see him.

units.zh: 其後人有上書告勃欲反，下廷尉。
units.en: In time, someone submitted a memorial accusing Bo of plotting rebellion, and the case was referred to the Commandant of Justice.
units.literal: Afterwards someone submitted a memorial accusing Bo of intending rebellion, sent to the Chamberlain for Law Enforcement.

units.zh: 廷尉下其事長安，逮捕勃治之。
units.en: The Commandant of Justice referred the matter to Chang'an, and Bo was arrested and brought in for interrogation.
units.literal: The Chamberlain for Law Enforcement sent the matter to Chang'an, arrested Bo for investigation.

units.zh: 勃恐，不知置辭。
units.en: Bo was terrified and at a loss for how to defend himself.
units.literal: Bo was terrified, did not know how to respond.

units.zh: 吏稍侵辱之。
units.en: The officials steadily pressed and humiliated him.
units.literal: The officials gradually humiliated him.

units.zh: 勃以千金與獄吏，獄吏乃書牘背示之，曰「以公主為證」。
units.en: Bo gave a thousand jin of gold to the prison officials, who then wrote on the back of a wooden tablet and showed it to him: "Call the princess as your witness."
units.literal: Bo gave a thousand jin of gold to the prison officials, the prison officials then wrote on the back of the documents to show him, saying 'Use the princess as witness.'

units.zh: 公主者，孝文帝女也，勃太子勝之尚之，故獄吏教引為證。
units.en: The princess was Emperor Wen's daughter; Bo's heir, Shengzhi, had married her. That is why the prison officials advised him to call upon her as a witness.
units.literal: The princess was Emperor Xiaowen's daughter, Bo's heir Shengzhi married her, so the prison officials taught to cite her as witness.

units.zh: 勃之益封受賜，盡以予薄昭。
units.en: Bo had given all of his additional enfeoffments and rewards to Bo Zhao.
units.literal: Bo's increased enfeoffments and rewards, all gave to Bo Zhao.

units.zh: 及系急，薄昭為言薄太后，太后亦以為無反事。
units.en: When Bo's imprisonment grew dire, Bo Zhao interceded with Empress Dowager Bo, who likewise believed there was no truth to the charge of rebellion.
units.literal: When the imprisonment was urgent, Bo Zhao spoke to Empress Bo, the empress also considered there was no rebellion matter.

units.zh: 文帝朝，太后以冒絮提文帝，曰：「絳侯綰皇帝璽，將兵於北軍，不以此時反，今居一小縣，顧欲反邪！」
units.en: At Emperor Wen's morning audience, the Empress Dowager seized the emperor by his headdress cloth and said: "The Marquis of Jiang once held the imperial seal in his hands and commanded the Northern Army. If he did not rebel then, why would he now, living in some small county, suddenly wish to rebel?"
units.literal: In Emperor Wen's court, the empress lifted Emperor Wen by the front of his robe, said: 'The Marquis of Jiang grasped the emperor's seal, led troops in the northern army, did not rebel at that time, now resides in a small county, why would he want to rebel!'

units.zh: 文帝既見絳侯獄辭，乃謝曰：「吏［事］方驗而出之。」
units.en: After Emperor Wen reviewed the Marquis of Jiang's prison deposition, he apologized and said: "The officials are finishing their verification, and he will be released."
units.literal: After Emperor Wen had seen the Marquis of Jiang's prison deposition, he apologized and said: "The officials are finishing their verification, and he will be released."

units.zh: 於是使使持節赦絳侯，復爵邑。
units.en: He thereupon dispatched envoys bearing the imperial tally to pardon the Marquis of Jiang and restore his rank and fief.
units.literal: Thus, sent envoys holding the tally to pardon the Marquis of Jiang, restored rank and fief.

units.zh: 絳侯既出，曰：「吾嘗將百萬軍，然安知獄吏之貴乎！」
units.en: Upon his release, the Marquis of Jiang sighed: "I once commanded an army of a million men, yet how could I have known the true worth of a prison official!"
units.literal: The Marquis of Jiang having been released, said: 'I once commanded a million troops, yet how could I know the preciousness of prison officials!'

units.zh: 絳侯復就國。
units.en: The Marquis of Jiang returned once more to his fief.
units.literal: The Marquis of Jiang again went to his fief.

units.zh: 孝文帝十一年卒，謚為武侯。
units.en: He died in the eleventh year of Emperor Wen's reign and was given the posthumous title of Marquis Wu.
units.literal: Emperor Xiaowen year 11 died, posthumous title Marquis Wu.

units.zh: 子勝之代侯。
units.en: His son Shengzhi succeeded to the marquisate.
units.literal: Son Shengzhi succeeded to the marquisate.

units.zh: 六歲，尚公主，不相中，坐殺人，國除。
units.en: After six years, he married a princess, but the match was unhappy; he was convicted of murder, and his marquisate was abolished.
units.literal: Six years, married the princess, did not get along, because of killing someone, state abolished.

units.zh: 絕一歲，文帝乃擇絳侯勃子賢者河內守亞夫，封為條侯，續絳侯後。
units.en: After a lapse of one year, Emperor Wen chose the most worthy of the Marquis of Jiang's sons, Yafu, who was then serving as Governor of Henei, and enfeoffed him as the Marquis of Tiao to continue the line of the Marquis of Jiang.
units.literal: After a lapse of one year, Emperor Wen then selected the Marquis of Jiang's worthy son, the Governor of Henei, Yafu, and enfeoffed him as Marquis of Tiao to continue the Marquis of Jiang's line.

units.zh: 條侯亞夫自未侯為河內守時，許負相之，曰：「君後三歲而侯。
units.en: When the Marquis of Tiao, Yafu, was not yet a marquis and was still serving as Governor of Henei, the physiognomist Xu Fu read his face and said: "In three years you will become a marquis.
units.literal: When the Marquis of Tiao, Yafu, was not yet a marquis and was serving as Governor of Henei, Xu Fu read his face and said: "In three years you will become a marquis.

units.zh: 侯八歲為將相，持國秉，貴重矣，於人臣無兩。
units.en: Eight years after becoming a marquis, you will serve as general and chancellor, holding the reins of state, honored and powerful beyond any other minister.
units.literal: Marquis eight years will be general and chancellor, hold the state's reins, honored and important, among ministers unparalleled.

units.zh: 其後九歲而君餓死。」
units.en: But nine years after that, you will die of starvation."
units.literal: Afterwards nine years sir will starve to death.'

units.zh: 亞夫笑曰：「臣之兄已代父侯矣，有如卒，子當代，亞夫何說侯乎？
units.en: Yafu laughed and said: "My elder brother has already succeeded our father as marquis. Should he die, his own son will inherit. How could Yafu ever become a marquis?
units.literal: Yafu laughed saying: 'My elder brother has already succeeded father as marquis, if he dies, his son should succeed, why would Yafu become marquis?

units.zh: 然既已貴如負言，又何說餓死？
units.en: And if I am to become as honored as you say, then why speak of starving to death?
units.literal: Yet if already honored as Fu said, why speak of starving to death?

units.zh: 指示我。」
units.en: Show me the sign."
units.literal: Show me.'

units.zh: 許負指其口曰：「有從理入口，此餓死法也。」
units.en: Xu Fu pointed to his mouth and said: "There is a vertical crease running into the mouth. This is the mark of death by starvation."
units.literal: Xu Fu pointed to his mouth saying: 'There is a vertical line entering the mouth, this is the method of starving to death.'

units.zh: 居三歲，其兄絳侯勝之有罪，孝文帝擇絳侯子賢者，皆推亞夫，乃封亞夫為條侯，續絳侯後。
units.en: Three years later, his elder brother Shengzhi, the Marquis of Jiang, was found guilty of a crime. Emperor Wen selected from among the Marquis of Jiang's sons the most worthy; all agreed on Yafu. He was enfeoffed as the Marquis of Tiao to carry on the line of the Marquis of Jiang.
units.literal: After three years, his elder brother Marquis Jiang Shengzhi committed a crime, Emperor Xiaowen selected the Marquis of Jiang's worthy sons, all recommended Yafu, so enfeoffed Yafu as Marquis of Tiao, continued the Marquis of Jiang's line.

units.zh: 文帝之後六年，匈奴大入邊。
units.en: In the latter sixth year of Emperor Wen's reign, the Xiongnu launched a major invasion of the frontier.
units.literal: Six years after Emperor Wen, the Xiongnu greatly invaded the border.

units.zh: 乃以宗正劉禮為將軍，軍霸上；
units.en: The Director of the Imperial Clan, Liu Li, was appointed general and stationed at Bashang.
units.literal: Thus, appointed the Imperial Clan Court Minister Liu Li as general, stationed at Bashang;

units.zh: 祝茲侯徐厲為將軍，軍棘門；
units.en: The Marquis of Zhuzi, Xu Li, was made general and stationed at Jimen.
units.literal: Marquis Zhuzi Xu Li as general, stationed at Jimen;

units.zh: 以河內守亞夫為將軍，軍細柳：以備胡。
units.en: Yafu, the Governor of Henei, was appointed general and stationed at Xiliu to guard against the Xiongnu.
units.literal: appointed Henei governor Yafu as general, stationed at Xiliu: to prepare against the Xiongnu.

units.zh: 上自勞軍。
units.en: The emperor went in person to inspect the troops.
units.literal: The emperor personally inspected the troops.

units.zh: 至霸上及棘門軍，直馳入，將以下騎送迎。
units.en: At the camps of Bashang and Jimen, he rode straight in, and the generals and their subordinates galloped out on horseback to welcome him.
units.literal: Arriving at Bashang and Jimen armies, drove straight in, the generals and below rode to greet.

units.zh: 已而之細柳軍，軍士吏被甲，銳兵刃，彀弓弩，持滿。
units.en: When he came to the camp at Xiliu, however, the soldiers and officers were in full armor, their weapons honed to a keen edge, and their bows and crossbows drawn to full tension.
units.literal: Soon went to the Xiliu army, the soldiers and officers wore armor, sharpened weapons and blades, drew bows and crossbows, held them at full draw.

units.zh: 天子先驅至，不得入。
units.en: The emperor's advance riders arrived but were refused entry.
units.literal: The emperor's advance guard arrived, could not enter.

units.zh: 先驅曰：「天子且至！」
units.en: The advance riders protested: "The Son of Heaven is about to arrive!"
units.literal: The advance guard said: 'The Son of Heaven is about to arrive!'

units.zh: 軍門都尉曰：「將軍令曰『軍中聞將軍令，不聞天子之詔』。」
units.en: The gate commandant replied: "The general's standing order is: 'Within this camp, obey the general's commands; the decrees of the Son of Heaven do not apply here.'"
units.literal: The gate commandant replied: "The general's order says, 'Within the camp, obey the general's commands; do not heed the Son of Heaven's decrees.'"

units.zh: 居無何，上至，又不得入。
units.en: Before long the emperor himself arrived, and he too was denied entry.
units.literal: Shortly after, the emperor arrived, again could not enter.

units.zh: 於是上乃使使持節詔將軍：「吾欲入勞軍。」
units.en: The emperor then dispatched envoys bearing the imperial tally to inform the general: "I wish to enter the camp and inspect the troops."
units.literal: Thus, the emperor sent envoys holding the tally to decree the general: 'I wish to enter and inspect the army.'

units.zh: 亞夫乃傳言開壁門。
units.en: Only then did Yafu give the order to open the rampart gates.
units.literal: Yafu then transmitted orders to open the rampart gate.

units.zh: 壁門士吏謂從屬車騎曰：「將軍約，軍中不得驅馳。」
units.en: The soldiers at the gate informed the imperial entourage: "By the general's regulation, no galloping is permitted within the camp."
units.literal: The rampart gate soldiers and officers told the following chariots and cavalry: 'The general's agreement—no driving and galloping in the army.'

units.zh: 於是天子乃按轡徐行。
units.en: The Son of Heaven drew in his reins and proceeded at a walk.
units.literal: Thus, the Son of Heaven held the reins and walked slowly.

units.zh: 至營，將軍亞夫持兵揖曰：「介胄之士不拜，請以軍禮見。」
units.en: When they reached the command tent, General Yafu, weapon in hand, gave a military salute and said: "A man in armor cannot perform the full obeisance. I beg leave to greet Your Majesty with the rites of the camp."
units.literal: Arriving at the camp, General Yafu held his weapon and bowed saying: 'Armored soldiers do not bow, please receive with military ritual.'

units.zh: 天子為動，改容式車。
units.en: The Son of Heaven was visibly moved. He composed his expression and leaned forward on the rail of his chariot in a gesture of respect.
units.literal: The Son of Heaven was moved, changed expression and stood in the chariot.

units.zh: 使人稱謝：「皇帝敬勞將軍。」
units.en: He had an attendant convey his words: "The emperor respectfully commends the general."
units.literal: He had someone convey thanks: "The emperor respectfully commends the general."

units.zh: 成禮而去。
units.en: The ceremony concluded, and the emperor departed.
units.literal: Completed the ritual and left.

units.zh: 既出軍門，群臣皆驚。
units.en: After they had passed through the camp gate, every minister in the retinue was astonished.
units.literal: Having left the army gate, all the ministers were astonished.

units.zh: 文帝曰：「嗟乎，此真將軍矣！
units.en: Emperor Wen exclaimed: "Ah, now that is a true general!
units.literal: Emperor Wen said: 'Alas, this is truly a general!

units.zh: 曩者霸上、棘門軍，若兒戲耳，其將固可襲而虜也。
units.en: The camps at Bashang and Jimen were no better than children at play. Their generals could easily have been caught off guard and taken prisoner.
units.literal: Previously the Bashang and Jimen armies were like children's play, their generals could certainly be surprised and captured.

units.zh: 至於亞夫，可得而犯邪！」
units.en: But Yafu, could any enemy dare challenge him?"
units.literal: As for Yafu, can he be offended?'

units.zh: 稱善者久之。
units.en: He went on praising Yafu for a long while.
units.literal: Praised him for a long time.

units.zh: 月餘，三軍皆罷。
units.en: After more than a month, the three armies were all disbanded.
units.literal: More than a month, the three armies were all disbanded.

units.zh: 乃拜亞夫為中尉。
units.en: Yafu was thereupon appointed Commandant of the Capital Guard.
units.literal: Thus, appointed Yafu as Commandant of the Guards.

units.zh: 孝文且崩時，誡太子曰：「即有緩急，周亞夫真可任將兵。」
units.en: When Emperor Wen lay on his deathbed, he admonished the Crown Prince: "If ever there is an emergency, Zhou Yafu is the man you can truly entrust to command the army."
units.literal: When Emperor Xiaowen was about to pass away, admonished the crown prince saying: 'If there is emergency, Zhou Yafu truly can be entrusted to lead troops.'

units.zh: 文帝崩，拜亞夫為車騎將軍。
units.en: After Emperor Wen passed away, Yafu was appointed General of Chariots and Cavalry.
units.literal: Emperor Wen passed away, appointed Yafu as Chariot and Cavalry General.

units.zh: 孝景三年，吳楚反。
units.en: In the third year of Emperor Jing's reign, Wu and Chu rose in rebellion.
units.literal: Emperor Jing year 3, Wu and Chu rebelled.

units.zh: 亞夫以中尉為太尉，東擊吳楚。
units.en: Yafu was promoted from Commandant of the Capital Guard to Grand Commandant and sent east to campaign against Wu and Chu.
units.literal: Yafu as Commandant of the Guards became Grand Commandant, east attacked Wu and Chu.

units.zh: 因自請上曰：「楚兵剽輕，難與爭鋒。
units.en: He personally petitioned the emperor: "The troops of Chu are swift and aggressive; it would be unwise to confront them head-on.
units.literal: Thus, personally requested the emperor saying: 'Chu troops are fierce and swift, difficult to contend with directly.

units.zh: 願以梁委之，絕其糧道，乃可制。」
units.en: I ask that we let Liang absorb their attack while we cut off their supply lines; only then can we bring them under control."
units.literal: I wish to let Liang bear their assault while we cut off their grain routes; only then can we bring them under control."

units.zh: 上許之。
units.en: The emperor approved the plan.
units.literal: The emperor permitted it.

units.zh: 太尉既會兵滎陽，吳方攻梁，梁急，請救。
units.en: After the Grand Commandant had assembled his forces at Xingyang, Wu was pressing its attack on Liang. Liang was in dire straits and begged for relief.
units.literal: The Grand Commandant having assembled troops at Xingyang, Wu was attacking Liang, Liang was urgent, requested rescue.

units.zh: 太尉引兵東北走昌邑，深壁而守。
units.en: The Grand Commandant marched his troops northeast to Changyi, where he dug in deep and held his position.
units.literal: The Grand Commandant led troops northeast to Changyi, entrenched deeply and defended.

units.zh: 梁日使使請太尉，太尉守便宜，不肯往。
units.en: Liang sent envoys day after day imploring the Grand Commandant, but he held firm to his strategic advantage and refused to move.
units.literal: Liang daily sent envoys to request the Grand Commandant, the Grand Commandant held to what was advantageous, would not go.

units.zh: 梁上書言景帝，景帝使使詔救梁。
units.en: Liang appealed directly to Emperor Jing in a memorial, and the emperor dispatched envoys with a decree ordering the Grand Commandant to rescue Liang.
units.literal: Liang submitted a memorial to Emperor Jing, Emperor Jing sent envoys to decree rescue Liang.

units.zh: 太尉不奉詔，堅壁不出，而使輕騎兵弓高侯等絕吳楚兵後食道。
units.en: The Grand Commandant declined to obey the decree. He held his entrenchments and refused to sally forth, but sent the Marquis of Gonggao with light cavalry to sever the supply lines behind the Wu and Chu forces.
units.literal: The Grand Commandant did not obey the decree, firmly entrenched without going out, but sent light cavalry general Gonggao Hou and others to cut off Wu and Chu troops' rear grain routes.

units.zh: 吳兵乏糧，饑，數欲挑戰，終不出。
units.en: The Wu troops ran short of provisions and grew hungry. They repeatedly tried to provoke a battle, but the Grand Commandant would not come out.
units.literal: Wu troops lacked grain, hungry, several times wished to challenge, ultimately did not come out.

units.zh: 夜，軍中驚，內相攻擊擾亂，至於太尉帳下。
units.en: One night, panic swept through the camp. Soldiers attacked one another in the confusion, and the tumult reached the very entrance of the Grand Commandant's tent.
units.literal: At night, the army was alarmed, internally attacked each other in confusion, reaching the Grand Commandant's tent.

units.zh: 太尉終臥不起。
units.en: The Grand Commandant remained lying down and did not rise.
units.literal: The Grand Commandant lay still without rising.

units.zh: 頃之，復定。
units.en: Before long, order was restored.
units.literal: After a moment, again settled.

units.zh: 後吳奔壁東南陬，太尉使備西北。
units.en: Later, when the Wu forces charged toward the southeast corner of the ramparts, the Grand Commandant ordered his troops to reinforce the northwest instead.
units.literal: Later Wu fled toward the southeast corner of the wall, the Grand Commandant had them prepare northwest.

units.zh: 已而其精兵果奔西北，不得入。
units.en: Sure enough, the enemy's elite forces soon rushed the northwest, but they could not break through.
units.literal: Soon their elite troops indeed fled northwest, could not enter.

units.zh: 吳兵既餓，乃引而去。
units.en: The Wu troops, now starving, finally withdrew.
units.literal: Wu troops having starved, then led away.

units.zh: 太尉出精兵追擊，大破之。
units.en: The Grand Commandant unleashed his elite troops in pursuit and inflicted a devastating defeat.
units.literal: The Grand Commandant sent out elite troops to pursue and strike, greatly broke them.

units.zh: 吳王濞棄其軍，而與壯士數千人亡走，保於江南丹徒。
units.en: The King of Wu, Bi, abandoned his army and fled with several thousand of his strongest men, taking refuge at Dantu south of the Yangtze.
units.literal: Wu King Bi abandoned his army, and with several thousand strong men fled and ran, defended in Jiangnan Dantu.

units.zh: 漢兵因乘勝，遂盡虜之，降其兵，購吳王千金。
units.en: The Han forces pressed their advantage and captured every last one, accepting the surrender of the remaining troops and placing a bounty of a thousand jin of gold on the King of Wu.
units.literal: Han troops thus took advantage of victory, completely captured them, surrendered their troops, offered thousand jin bounty for Wu King.

units.zh: 月餘，越人斬吳王頭以告。
units.en: Over a month later, the Yue people beheaded the King of Wu and sent his head as proof.
units.literal: More than a month, Yue people beheaded Wu King to report.

units.zh: 凡相攻守三月，而吳楚破平。
units.en: In all, the campaign of attack and defense lasted three months before Wu and Chu were utterly defeated and pacified.
units.literal: Altogether attacked and defended three months, Wu and Chu were broken and pacified.

units.zh: 於是諸將乃以太尉計謀為是。
units.en: The generals then acknowledged that the Grand Commandant's strategy had been right all along.
units.literal: Thus, the generals considered the Grand Commandant's strategy correct.

units.zh: 由此梁孝王與太尉有卻。
units.en: From this time on, King Xiao of Liang bore a lasting grudge against the Grand Commandant.
units.literal: From this Liang Xiaowang had resentment toward the Grand Commandant.

units.zh: 歸，復置太尉官。
units.en: Upon his return, the office of Grand Commandant was reestablished.
units.literal: Returned, again established the Grand Commandant office.

units.zh: 五歲，遷為丞相，景帝甚重之。
units.en: Five years later, he was promoted to chancellor, and Emperor Jing esteemed him greatly.
units.literal: Five years, promoted to chancellor, Emperor Jing greatly valued him.

units.zh: 景帝廢栗太子，丞相固爭之，不得。
units.en: When Emperor Jing deposed Crown Prince Li, the chancellor argued strenuously against it but could not prevail.
units.literal: Emperor Jing deposed Crown Prince Li, the chancellor firmly contended against it, could not prevail.

units.zh: 景帝由此疏之。
units.en: From that point on, Emperor Jing grew distant toward him.
units.literal: Emperor Jing from this distanced him.

units.zh: 而梁孝王每朝，常與太后言條侯之短。
units.en: Moreover, each time King Xiao of Liang attended court, he would speak to the Empress Dowager of the Marquis of Tiao's failings.
units.literal: Moreover, Liang Xiaowang each court audience, often spoke of Marquis Tiao's faults to the empress dowager.

units.zh: 竇太后曰：「皇后兄王信可侯也。」
units.en: Empress Dowager Dou said: "The empress's elder brother, Wang Xin, should be made a marquis."
units.literal: Empress Dowager Dou said: 'The queen's elder brother Wang Xin can be made marquis.'

units.zh: 景帝讓曰：「始南皮、章武侯先帝不侯，及臣即位乃侯之。
units.en: Emperor Jing demurred: "The late emperor did not enfeoff the Marquises of Nanpi and Zhangwu; it was only after I came to the throne that they were made marquises.
units.literal: Emperor Jing declined saying: 'Originally Nanpi and Zhangwu marquises the late emperor did not make marquises, when I ascended the throne then made them marquises.

units.zh: 信未得封也。」
units.en: Xin has not yet received an enfeoffment."
units.literal: Xin has not yet received enfeoffment.'

units.zh: 竇太后曰：「人主各以時行耳。
units.en: Empress Dowager Dou said: "Every sovereign acts as the times require.
units.literal: Empress Dowager Dou said: 'Rulers each act according to their time.

units.zh: 自竇長君在時，竟不得侯，死後乃［封］其子彭祖顧得侯。
units.en: While Dou Changjun was still alive, he never managed to become a marquis. It was only after his death that his son Pengzu finally received the title.
units.literal: From when Dou Changjun was alive, ultimately could not become marquis, after death then [enfeoffed] his son Pengzu and he became marquis.

units.zh: 吾甚恨之。
units.en: I have always deeply regretted this.
units.literal: I greatly resent it.

units.zh: 帝趣侯信也！」
units.en: Make haste and enfeoff Wang Xin!"
units.literal: Your majesty quickly make Xin marquis!'

units.zh: 景帝曰：「請得與丞相議之。」
units.en: Emperor Jing replied: "Allow me to discuss the matter with the chancellor."
units.literal: Emperor Jing said: 'Please allow me to discuss with the chancellor.'

units.zh: 丞相議之，亞夫曰：「高皇帝約『非劉氏不得王，非有功不得侯。
units.en: When the matter was put to the chancellor, Yafu replied: "Emperor Gaozu's covenant states: 'None who is not of the Liu clan may be made king; none without merit may be made marquis.
units.literal: When the emperor consulted the chancellor, Yafu said: "Emperor Gaozu's covenant states: 'None who is not of the Liu clan may be made king; none without merit may be made marquis.

units.zh: 不如約，天下共擊之』。
units.en: Any who violate this covenant shall be attacked by the whole realm.'
units.literal: If not follow the covenant, the realm together will attack them'.

units.zh: 今信雖皇后兄，無功，侯之，非約也。」
units.en: Now, although Wang Xin is the empress's brother, he has no merit. To make him a marquis would violate the covenant."
units.literal: Now Xin though queen's elder brother, without merit, make him marquis, not follow the covenant."

units.zh: 景帝默然而止。
units.en: Emperor Jing fell silent and let the matter drop.
units.literal: Emperor Jing was silent and stopped.

units.zh: 其後匈奴王［唯］徐盧等五人降，景帝欲侯之以勸後。
units.en: Some time later, the Xiongnu king Xu Lu and four others surrendered. Emperor Jing wished to enfeoff them as marquises to encourage future defections.
units.literal: Afterwards Xiongnu kings [Wei] Xu Lu and others five people surrendered, Emperor Jing wished to make them marquises to encourage later surrenders.

units.zh: 丞相亞夫曰：「彼背其主降陛下，陛下侯之，則何以責人臣不守節者乎？」
units.en: Chancellor Yafu objected: "These men betrayed their own lord to surrender to Your Majesty. If Your Majesty rewards them with marquisates, by what standard can you censure ministers who fail to keep faith?"
units.literal: Chancellor Yafu said: 'They betrayed their lord and surrendered to your majesty, your majesty makes them marquises, then how to blame ministers who do not maintain loyalty?'

units.zh: 景帝曰：「丞相議不可用。」
units.en: Emperor Jing declared: "The chancellor's advice is unacceptable."
units.literal: Emperor Jing said: 'The chancellor's counsel cannot be used.'

units.zh: 乃悉封［唯］徐盧等為列侯。
units.en: He proceeded to enfeoff Xu Lu and the others as marquises, every one of them.
units.literal: Thus, all enfeoffed [Wei] Xu Lu and others as nobles.

units.zh: 亞夫因謝病。
units.en: Yafu thereupon pleaded illness and withdrew.
units.literal: Yafu thus pleaded illness.

units.zh: 景帝中三年，以病免相。
units.en: In the middle third year of Emperor Jing's reign, he was dismissed from the chancellorship on grounds of illness.
units.literal: Emperor Jing middle year 3, because of illness dismissed from chancellor.

units.zh: 頃之，景帝居禁中，召條侯，賜食。
units.en: Not long afterward, Emperor Jing, from within the inner palace, summoned the Marquis of Tiao and offered him a meal.
units.literal: Shortly after, Emperor Jing resided in the inner palace, summoned Marquis Tiao, granted food.

units.zh: 獨置大胾，無切肉，又不置櫡。
units.en: Before him was placed a single large joint of meat, but there was no knife to cut it with, nor were there any chopsticks.
units.literal: Alone placed a large joint of meat, no knife for cutting, also did not place chopsticks.

units.zh: 條侯心不平，顧謂尚席取櫡。
units.en: The Marquis of Tiao was displeased. He turned and asked the steward to fetch chopsticks.
units.literal: Marquis Tiao's heart was not at peace, turned and told the food attendant to get chopsticks.

units.zh: 景帝視而笑曰：「此不足君所乎？」
units.en: Emperor Jing watched and said with a smile: "Is this not enough for you?"
units.literal: Emperor Jing watched and laughed saying: 'This is not enough for sir?'

units.zh: 條侯免冠謝。
units.en: The Marquis of Tiao removed his cap and apologized.
units.literal: Marquis Tiao removed his cap and apologized.

units.zh: 上起，條侯因趨出。
units.en: When the emperor rose, the Marquis of Tiao hastily withdrew.
units.literal: The emperor rose, Marquis Tiao thus hurried out.

units.zh: 景帝以目送之，曰：「此怏怏者非少主臣也！」
units.en: Emperor Jing watched him go and remarked: "This sullen man is not one to serve a young ruler!"
units.literal: Emperor Jing followed with his eyes, said: 'This discontented one is not a minister for a young lord!'

units.zh: 居無何，條侯子為父買工官尚方甲楯五百被可以葬者。
units.en: Not long after, the Marquis of Tiao's son purchased five hundred suits of armor and shields from the Imperial Workshop for use as burial goods for his father.
units.literal: After not long, Marquis Tiao's son for father bought from the artisan office Shangfang five hundred suits of armor and shields that could be used for burial.

units.zh: 取庸苦之，不予錢。
units.en: He hired laborers to transport them but worked them harshly and refused to pay.
units.literal: Took laborers to work them hard, did not give money.

units.zh: 庸知其盜買縣官器，怒而上變告子，事連汙條侯。
units.en: The laborers, aware that government equipment had been illicitly purchased, were enraged and reported the crime, accusing the son. The case implicated the Marquis of Tiao himself.
units.literal: The laborers knew they were illicitly buying government equipment, angered and reported the irregularity, accusing the son, the matter implicated and defiled Marquis Tiao.

units.zh: 書既聞上，上下吏。
units.en: When the report reached the emperor, he ordered officials to investigate.
units.literal: The memorial having reached the emperor, sent down officials.

units.zh: 吏簿責條侯，條侯不對。
units.en: The officials interrogated the Marquis of Tiao based on the charges, but the marquis refused to answer.
units.literal: The officials interrogated Marquis Tiao according to the records, Marquis Tiao did not answer.

units.zh: 景帝罵之曰：「吾不用也。」
units.en: Emperor Jing rebuked him, saying: "I have no need of you."
units.literal: Emperor Jing cursed saying: 'I will not employ you.'

units.zh: 召詣廷尉。
units.en: He was summoned before the Commandant of Justice.
units.literal: Summoned to the Chamberlain for Law Enforcement.

units.zh: 廷尉責曰：「君侯欲反邪？」
units.en: The Commandant of Justice interrogated him: "Does the marquis intend to rebel?"
units.literal: The Chamberlain for Law Enforcement interrogated saying: 'Marquis wishes to rebel?'

units.zh: 亞夫曰：「臣所買器，乃葬器也，何謂反邪？」
units.en: Yafu replied: "What I purchased were burial goods. How can you call that rebellion?"
units.literal: Yafu said: "What I purchased were burial goods. How can you call that rebellion?"

units.zh: 吏曰：「君侯縱不反地上，即欲反地下耳。」
units.en: The officials retorted: "Even if the marquis does not intend to rebel above ground, he surely means to rebel underground."
units.literal: The officials said: 'Even if marquis does not rebel on the earth, he wishes to rebel under the earth.'

units.zh: 吏侵之益急。
units.en: The officials pressed their accusations more and more harshly.
units.literal: The officials pressed him increasingly urgently.

units.zh: 初，吏捕條侯，條侯欲自殺，夫人止之，以故不得死，遂入廷尉。
units.en: When the officials first came to arrest the Marquis of Tiao, he had wished to take his own life, but his wife stopped him. Unable to die, he was brought before the Commandant of Justice.
units.literal: Initially when officials arrested Marquis Tiao, Marquis Tiao wished to commit suicide, his wife stopped him, because of this could not die, thus entered the Chamberlain for Law Enforcement.

units.zh: 因不食五日，嘔血而死。
units.en: He refused to eat for five days, vomited blood, and died.
units.literal: Thus, did not eat for five days, vomited blood and died.

units.zh: 國除。
units.en: His marquisate was abolished.
units.literal: State abolished.

units.zh: 絕一歲，景帝乃更封絳侯勃他子堅為平曲侯，續絳侯後。
units.en: After a lapse of one year, Emperor Jing enfeoffed another of the Marquis of Jiang's sons, Jian, as the Marquis of Pingqu to carry on the line.
units.literal: Cut off for one year, Emperor Jing then re-enfeoffed Marquis Jiang Bo's other son Jian as Marquis of Pingqu, continued the Marquis of Jiang's line.

units.zh: 十九年卒，謚為共侯。
units.en: He died after nineteen years and was given the posthumous title of Marquis Gong.
units.literal: Nineteen years died, posthumous title Marquis Gong.

units.zh: 子建德代侯，十三年，為太子太傅。
units.en: His son Jiande succeeded to the marquisate. After thirteen years, he was appointed Grand Tutor to the Crown Prince.
units.literal: Son Jiande succeeded to the marquisate, thirteen years, served as crown prince tutor.

units.zh: 坐酎金不善，元鼎五年，有罪，國除。
units.en: He was found guilty of presenting substandard tribute gold in the fifth year of the Yuanding era, and his marquisate was abolished.
units.literal: Because of unsatisfactory tribute wine, Yuanding year 5, had crime, state abolished.

units.zh: 條侯果餓死。
units.en: The Marquis of Tiao did indeed die of starvation.
units.literal: Marquis Tiao indeed starved to death.

units.zh: 死後，景帝乃封王信為蓋侯。
units.en: After his death, Emperor Jing enfeoffed Wang Xin as the Marquis of Gai.
units.literal: After death, Emperor Jing then enfeoffed Wang Xin as Marquis of Gai.

units.zh: 太史公曰：絳侯周勃始為布衣時，鄙樸人也，才能不過凡庸。
units.en: The Grand Historian remarks: When the Marquis of Jiang, Zhou Bo, was still a commoner, he was an unpolished rustic of no more than ordinary ability.
units.literal: The Grand Historian says: Marquis Jiang Zhou Bo when beginning as commoner, was a vulgar rustic, ability no more than ordinary.

units.zh: 及從高祖定天下，在將相位，諸呂欲作亂，勃匡國家難，復之乎正。
units.en: Yet when he followed Emperor Gaozu to pacify the realm and rose to the rank of general and chancellor, and when the Lu clan plotted to seize power, it was Bo who saved the state in its hour of peril and restored it to the rightful course.
units.literal: When followed Gaozu to settle the realm, in general and chancellor position, the various Lü wished to make rebellion, Bo rectified the state's difficulties, returned it to correctness.

units.zh: 雖伊尹、周公，何以加哉！
units.en: Even Yi Yin and the Duke of Zhou could scarcely have done more!
units.literal: Even Yi Yin and Zhou Gong, what could surpass this!

units.zh: 亞夫之用兵，持威重，執堅刃，穰苴曷有加焉！
units.en: As for Yafu's command of armies, maintaining stern authority and wielding iron discipline, even Rangju could not have surpassed him!
units.literal: Yafu's use of troops, held authority and weight, grasped firm blade, Rang Ju what could surpass this!

units.zh: 足己而不學，守節不遜，終以窮困。
units.en: Yet he was self-satisfied and unwilling to learn, unyielding in his principles to the point of obstinacy, and in the end came to ruin.
units.literal: Satisfied with himself and unwilling to learn, he held to his principles without deference, and in the end met with ruin.

units.zh: 悲夫！
units.en: How tragic!
units.literal: Alas!
